lessons.title: It's raining now
lessons.canDo: Say what is happening now and suggest plans
lessons.scenario: It starts raining outside the garden, so Smarty and Sam make indoor plans.

items.note: Say 'It is raining' when rain is falling right at this moment.
Use 'now' to talk about this very moment.
Say 'outside' for the open air out of your home or room.

image.describe: Smarty the black cat looking through a window at rain falling outside in the garden

items.note: Start a suggestion with 'Let's' when you want to do something together with a friend.

grammar.title: Now vs. Every Day & Let's
grammar.explanation: Use 'It rains in autumn' for habits, and 'It is raining now' for right this moment. Use 'Let's + action' (Let's play, Let's paint) to suggest a fun plan.
examples: It rains in autumn, and it is raining now.
It is raining outside. Let's paint!

practice.prompt: Look! Water is falling from the sky right at this moment. Which fits?
practice.explanation: Use 'It is raining now' for rain happening right now.

options: It is raining outside. Let's play a game!
It is sunny outside. Let's play tennis!

practice.explanation: Let's introduces a plan to play a game inside.
